name: Hello Retail
description:
Hello Retail is an ecommerce personalisation platform covering Search, Recommendations, Pages, Newsletter Content and AI-driven Product Agents. This connector gives Claude direct access to a website's Hello Retail setup and performance data, so you can investigate and change configuration in conversation instead of clicking through the dashboard.

Search: list search configurations, read and replace filters, sort options, initial content and link content, manage synonyms and stop words, and edit search designs (Liquid templates, CSS and init code).

Analytics: top searches, queries that returned nothing, which filters and sort options visitors actually use, and overall search performance for any window up to 92 days.

Recommendations: list recommendation boxes and designs, read a design, update its template and styles.

Product data: inspect every product and content field on a website, control which fields are indexed for filtering and sorting, and pull full product data or the change history for a single product.

Product feeds: create feeds from JSON, XML, JSONL or DSV sources with pagination, auth headers, delta runs and JavaScript transformation code, then check run history and per-field quality diagnostics to diagnose failed or slow imports.

Product Agents: list channels (Klaviyo or webhook) and pull analytics covering messages sent, revenue, revenue per message, open, click and conversion rates, broken down per agent and per day.

Built for ecommerce managers and developers running Hello Retail. Requires a Hello Retail account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Hello Retail to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Hello Retail to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://core.helloretail.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Hello Retail MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hello Retail lists 44 MCP tools, including createProductFeed, createSearchConfig, getContentFields, getLatestProductFeedRun, getProductAgentAnalytics, getProductAgentChannels, getProductChanges, getProductData, getProductFeed, getProductFeedRun, getProductFields, and getRecommendationDesign.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Hello Retail?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Hello Retail in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does Hello Retail MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hello Retail requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Hello Retail is developed by Hello Retail. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
